speaker: patient
text: Honestly, I just feel like I'm completely alone in this world. Nobody understands me, and I don't fit in anywhere.

speaker: patient
text: Even when I'm in a room full of people I know, I feel totally disconnected. Like there's a glass wall between me and everyone else.

speaker: patient
text: I could vanish off the face of the earth tomorrow and not a single person in my life would notice or care. I belong nowhere.

speaker: patient
text: There is no community, family, or friend group where I truly belong. I have never felt more isolated from human connection.

speaker: patient
text: I don't know why I bother showing up to Sunday dinner anymore. I just sit there and stare at my plate while they talk around me.

speaker: patient
text: My phone didn't ring once this entire weekend. Not that I expected it to. People have their own lives.

speaker: patient
text: Watching everyone laugh together in the breakroom while I eat lunch alone in my car... it's just a reminder of how separate I am.

speaker: patient
text: It’s just... whatever, you know? Like, if I wasn't there... they wouldn't even notice the empty chair.

speaker: patient
text: I try to talk to them but... it's like speaking a different language. So I just stopped trying.

speaker: patient
text: Nobody calls... and even if they did... what would I say? I'm just an alien in my own hometown.
